description: The state of Uttar Pradesh is gearing up to launch a transformative Quantum Mission, poised to bolster its technology framework. By focusing on quantum technology within a broader digital transformation agenda, the initiative aims to ignite innovation. At the ETGovernment AI Vision Conclave, leading industry figures explored the adoption of AI, investment avenues, and workforce readiness.
body_lead: The proposed mission will focus on building the state's capabilities in quantum technology, an emerging field that includes applications such as quantum computing and communication. The initiative is part of a broader strategy to attract investments, expand technology adoption and create opportunities for startups and businesses. Kumar outlined the state's digital transformation agenda and its efforts to position Uttar Pradesh to benefit from developments in next-generation technologies.
